title: Francisco Blasco
text:
About me
Welcome to my portfolio. I am an undergraduate student in International Economic Relations at the Federal University of Minas Gerais (UFMG) and researcher with the Executives, Presidents, and Cabinets Politics (PEX-Network) group, affiliated with the Center for Legislative Studies (CEL-DCP/UFMG).
My work is centered on political-economic analysis and the evaluation of public policies. I build structured datasets and apply quantitative methods to analyze Executive-Legislative dynamics and their impacts on economic development and institutional frameworks.
